BrochureContent.Content:
Excellent opportunity to acquire a substantial site measuring 0.8 of an acre.
This is a lovely flat site that veers away towards the rear offering appealing views of the surrounding countryside.
From the road entrance, the site offers a south east-facing aspect which offers an ideal situation for the construction of a private residence.
Site is 12km from Kilkenny.
Sold subject to planning permission.

Directions from Kilkenny.

Take the R693 road for 7.4km heading towards Freshford.
Turn left onto L5010 road for 3.2km.
Turn right & the site will be on the left...see sign !
